title: What's Forex?
overview: Kurumi enters the world of forex to prove she can succeed where her mother once failed.

title: It's Okay, I've Got Leverage
overview: After some advice from her friend Mochiko, Kurumi takes a risky position trading the Australian dollar.

title: Do I Have to Cut My Losses…?
overview: AUD/JPY takes Kurumi on a wild ride, and she finds herself at risk of losing all the money she "borrowed."

title: Having No Unrealized Losses Is the Best
overview: Kurumi has an awkward confrontation with her dad, and then gets roped into teaching forex to a new investor.

title: Long? Short? Which Do I Choose?
